newsitem.title: JAPAN: National Sec says capital safety ratio 174%.
newsitem.headline: National Sec says capital safety ratio 174%.

text.p: National Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday that its capital safety ratio at the end of March stood at 173.6 percent.

A ratio of below 150 percent is considered an early warning level and if it falls below 120 percent, financial authorities can order brokerages to improve their operations under the Securities and Exchange Law, an official at the Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA) said.
Japan's Securities and Exchange Law requires brokerages to disclose the ratio, which indicates their financial health.
The ratio is that of net capital and latent profits on securities holdings against risk assets and possible losses from the securities business, the official said.
